# Vendored TrustMark source

- Upstream: <https://github.com/adobe/trustmark>
- Crate release: `trustmark 0.2.2`
- Upstream commit recorded by crates.io: `0b49d6d523e6756f872a6b57bc543cedea58a616`
- Licence: MIT; see `LICENSE`

Underprint vendors this source so the native runtime can expose bounded
threading and allocator policy and remove avoidable image/tensor copies. Adobe
retains ownership of the upstream implementation. Underprint modifications are
documented in the repository history and must retain the upstream notice.
